items.text: According to published reviews, how do professional interpretation (in person, video or telephone), tested bilingual staff and ad hoc interpretation compare for patient-reported understanding, interpretation errors and satisfaction among patients who prefer a language other than that of their clinicians?
items.population: Patients in health care who prefer a language other than that of their clinicians
items.intervention: Professional interpretation by mode, and tested bilingual staff
items.comparator: Ad hoc interpretation or no interpretation; other professional modes
items.setting: Hospital and clinic care; reviews as the unit of analysis

finer: Feasible with one analyst two days a week and library support; interesting to the equity committee; novel because no overview handles overlap in this field; ethical as a review; relevant to an April 2027 decision.
summary: One PICO question with reviews as the unit of analysis.
